answer: An attester must prove it read what it signs. The ledger draws one checkable detail from each answer: the cost figure quoted and the delta between its stated numbers, restated in seven words. Miss it and 120 of the 400 POA bonded at join is slashed. Pairings follow the epoch hash, so nobody studies ahead; identical restatements fold into one vote. Forty honest reads cost ninety minutes and $3 of model time; a thousand clones need a thousand readers, $3,000 an epoch, and a slip burns the seat. A karst plateau drains through a thousand sinks; an atlas holds only the routes somebody walked.
